title: Layers of Pac
about: Made by Max and [Quirin](https://fischerq.de) for Ludum Dare 60, with Claude Code writing the code. We worked out of [Gasteig HP8](https://www.gasteig.de/) on Saturday and joined the [in-person jam at Die Gamerei](../event/) on Sunday. Every prompt is below, in order, with what it cost.
plan_note: Built on a Claude Max (20x) subscription, billed at a flat 214,20 € a month. The headline cost is the share of that subscription this project used, from the plan's weekly limit; API list prices are only a reference.

human_time.note: A rough estimate by Quirin and Claude, up to the end of the jam: mostly writing prompts, reviewing results and playtesting on the phone in between. About 10 h were focused blocks (Saturday 10:00–15:00, Sunday 10:00–13:00, Monday 22:00–24:00). About 7 h more went into short sessions on the go during the jam, counted from the prompts sent outside those blocks: each run of prompts sent within half an hour of each other, plus about 10 minutes to write the first and test the last. About 3 h went into the setup before the jam (picking the engine, the repo and Netlify, 21 prompts and their merges, at roughly 8 minutes a prompt like during the jam). Max's art time isn't included.
